lead_headline: Ultra Lounge West karaoke bar debuts in Westminster as 4 new restaurant leads surface

restaurant.blurb: 4 new leads today: Ultra Lounge West karaoke lounge (Westminster, just opened), Taqueria La Morenas (Harvey Park, replaced by Los Reyes Del Taco).

foreclosure.blurb: $6.1M Douglas County property at 18901 Longs Way leads this week's filings — the only entry clearing $4M threshold.

liquor.blurb: 4 new applications today — The Flaming Grill (14th Street hotel/restaurant), Pema (Larimer Street hotel/restaurant), Salon Theory (Tennessee Avenue beer/wine), and Moonlight Liquors (Tower retail license). One status shift: Radisson Hotel Denver Central slipped to delinquent. Seven-day filing pace surges to 23 applications — triple last week's 7-application count and the strongest weekly volume since mid-March.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention today brings the 7-day tally to 43 across 15 sources — down 25% from last week's 57-mention benchmark. Instagram (11), Denver Post (9), and X (5) anchor this week's distribution. Notable pickups include Denver Pavilions survival analysis, Stomp Athletics Shark Tank coverage, and DIA dining tier rankings. The week-over-week decline signals April's opening season peak has passed into normalized spring coverage after three weeks above baseline.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) lifts MTD to +17 (+1.0/day), 90-day net to +140. This week's +8 net (21 new, 13 canceled) trails last week's +10 by 20%, though new subscriber volume jumped 11% (21 vs 19) while cancellations climbed 44% (13 vs 9). The recent two-week pattern shows volatility: April 7-12 delivered +11 net before April 13-16's -2 net pullback. MTD's +1.0/day pace lags YTD's +1.4/day average as mid-month churn offsets early-April momentum.
